name: Bulk Edit Upsells and Cross-Sells for WooCommerce – Boost Sales and AOV with AI Product Recommendations for WooCommerce Upsells and Cross-Sells!
author: SaffireTech

sections.description:
Bulk Edit Upsells and Cross-sells for WooCommerce plugin allows you to boost your store sales by generating AI Product Recommendations using ChatGPT and enabling bulk update of WooCommerce UpSells and Cross-sells.

Say goodbye to tedious manual updates and hello to seamless AI-powered WooCommerce product suggestions! With Bulk Edit Upsells and Cross-Sells for WooCommerce, you can effortlessly manage your WooCommerce upsell, cross-sell items across your store. Powered by ChatGPT, our plugin delivers tailored AI product suggestions that elevate your store’s performance in just a few clicks!

For AI functionality, this plugin provides an extensive selection of ChatGPT AI models, including GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4, GPT-3.5 Turbo, and many more.

Please make sure you read the disclaimer.

Key Features of Bulk Edit Upsells and Cross-Sells for WooCommerce Plugin

  • AI Powered Product Suggestions
    Harness the power of AI to generate spot-on WooCommerce product suggestions for every item in your store by using this plugin! Simply select the items you want suggestions for, set the required criteria, and let ChatGPT handle the rest. Fine-tune your suggestions by pulling in key details like Product Name and Description, ensuring accurate and relevant upsell and cross-sell suggestions. Leverage these AI product suggestions seamlessly in your WooCommerce upsell and cross-sell sections to show the best item combinations to boost Average Order Value(AOV) and overall store sales.

  • Bulk Update WooCommerce Upsell Cross-sell
    Streamline your WooCommerce store management with quick and easy bulk updates for WooCommerce Upsell, Cross-sell items. Search for product recommendation using Product Name, Category, SKU, or Tags—filtering and finding the right items in seconds. Apply bulk updates to all matching products, and even copy and paste UpSell and Cross-Sell across different products, eliminating tedious repetition. Compatible with all WooCommerce product types—Simple, Variable, Grouped, or Downloadable!

With our Related Products Pro for WooCommerce plugin, the premium version of this plugin, you can take your WooCommerce sales to new heights, harnessing a suite of AI-powered features that will transform your selling strategy.

  1. AI Powered Product Suggestions for UpSells, Cross-Sells, and Related Products
    Let AI take charge with our groundbreaking feature, powered by ChatGPT! Once you set the criteria for the selected items, ChatGPT will provide you with smart and precise WooCommerce suggestions for Upsells, and Cross-sells—effortlessly. It’s like having your very own product expert working behind the scenes to maximize your sales by showcasing the perfect items in just minutes. Gain full control with the ‘Select All Products’ and ‘Select Categories’ options when choosing items you want AI product recommendation for. Plus, enjoy unlimited item selections when using the ‘Select Individual Products’ feature!

  2. Enhanced Product Details for Informed Choices
    You can now include Product URLs and Prices in your AI product suggestion. This enhancement allows for more detailed and informative WooCommerce item suggestions, giving your customers the necessary information to make informed purchasing decisions.

  3. Set AI Product suggestions for 50 Products in a Flash!
    Say goodbye to the hassle of updating items one by one. Now, you can effortlessly request AI product recommendations for upto 50 products in your store AT ONCE! A vast improvement over the free version that requires manual updates for each item. This powerful feature opens up a world of possibilities, allowing you to engage your customers more effectively and increase sales by showcasing a wider variety of WooCommerce item suggestions as per your needs. Perfect for larger stores, this capability not only boosts efficiency but also enhances your marketing strategy.

  4. Customize Your AI Prompts for Unmatched Product Suggestions!
    If you are an AI prompt expert, the new ‘Customize Default Prompt’ feature allows you to create customized prompts in ChatGPT, enabling you to tailor AI product suggestions to fit your store’s unique needs. By customizing prompts, you can ensure that the item suggestions resonate with your customer base, further enhancing their shopping experience and boosting your conversion rates.

  5. Display AI Product Suggestions Like Never Before with a Fully Customizable Slider!
    Our AJAX Slider feature transforms the way items are displayed in the Upsells Section. Say farewell to slow page loads. The PRO version ensures your customers enjoy a fast, fluid browsing experience, showcasing an unlimited number of items without compromising site speed. With initial loads set for immediate viewing and more items just a click away, customer engagement has never been smoother

  6. Effortlessly Track Every ChatGPT-Generated Prompt
    Maintain full control over your related products with a comprehensive log of all AI-generated suggestions. Monitor past prompts with detailed information, including date, time, status, options, and token usage, ensuring complete transparency. Need to refine a suggestion? The ‘Edit Product Recommendation’ feature lets you swiftly adjust WooCommerce Cross-sell, Upsells, and Related Products for precise and efficient updates.

By harnessing the power of Related Products Pro, you’ll not only increase sales but also foster deeper connections with your customers. Ready to take your store to new heights? Try the Related Products Pro for WooCommerce plugin now!

Your time is valuable

Finally, no more tedious clicking by going through each item to set upsells and cross-sells.

Copy and Paste

Now setting up WooCommerce Upsell, Cross-sell products has become even more easier, you can simply copy and paste upsells and cross-sells across different products in seconds.

Edit Quickly and with Confidence

Search for your products quickly using different search parameters like Name , Category, SKU, and Tags bulk update and save.

Boost Your Sales

Setting WooCommerce Upsell, Cross-sell products have never been easier.
Use this plugin to set them up quickly, increase product visibility and increase your sales in the process.

Disclaimer

Our plugin Bulk Edit UpSells and Cross-sells for WooCommerce is developed to ease the integration of large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT provided by OpenAI for getting product recommendation. To use AI functionality, users must supply their own API key, obtained from OpenAI.

By using our plugin, Bulk Edit UpSells and Cross-sells for WooCommerce, users are bound by the terms of use, privacy policy, and other legal agreements of Open AI.

By using our plugin, Bulk Edit UpSells and Cross-sells for WooCommerce, you acknowledge and agree to the following:

Bulk Edit UpSells and Cross-sells for WooCommerce serve as an intermediary tool for using AI services that allows you to share details of your items in your store on your request to AI in order to find the best possible item suggestions for your store.

Bulk Edit UpSells and Cross-sells for WooCommerce do not guarantee the accuracy or appropriateness of the item suggestions generated by the AI.

You are solely responsible for monitoring, reviewing, and managing the product recommendation generated by the Related Products for the WooCommerce plugin, as well as for dealing with any abuse or issues that may arise from its use.

Bulk Edit UpSells and Cross-sells for WooCommerce, its developer, SaffireTech, and any associated parties shall not be held liable for any damages or losses, direct or indirect, resulting from the use of the plugin or the item suggestions generated by the AI functionality.

You are responsible for ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations within your jurisdiction. This includes but is not limited to, adherence to privacy laws and regulations governing the use of artificial intelligence technology.

We advise you to exercise due caution and sound judgment when utilizing AI technology and to independently verify the accuracy and appropriateness of any item suggestions generated. It is important to stay informed about the potential limitations of large language models (LLMs), such as issues of hallucination or confabulation, which are widely discussed in available online resources.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the bulk-edit-upsells-and-cross-sells-for-woocommerce plugin folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Click on the \’Settings\’ link or in the WordPress dashboard click on Products > Upsells and Cross-sells
sections.faq:
1. Is it necessary to have a paid ChatGPT account to access the AI features?

Absolutely! To utilize the AI-powered product suggestions, you must have a paid ChatGPT account. This includes generating an API key and purchasing credits from OpenAI.

2. Can I refine AI product suggestions for more accurate suggestions?

Yes, you can fine-tune item suggestions by including more item details in your AI prompt. In the free version of Bulk Edit Upsells and Cross-sells for WooCommerce, you can only select Product Name and Description as Item Details. The premium version also offers you the Product URL and Price to include in your AI prompt to get the most relevant WooCommerce product suggestions.

3. Can I customize the AI prompt for product suggestions?

The Related Products Pro for WooCommerce allows you to customize the default prompt to create tailored suggested items that fit your store’s unique needs.

4. How many AI-powered product suggestions can I request at a time?

The Bulk Edit Upsells and Cross-Sells for WooCommerce lets you request up to 5 AI product suggestions and the premium version lets you set up to 10 AI product suggestions for Related products, Upsells, and Cross-sells. You can set these WooCommerce suggested items for up to 50 products on your store.

5. How does the AJAX slider improve the shopping experience?

The Pro version includes a customizable AJAX slider, which enables faster page loads and a smoother browsing experience by showcasing an unlimited number of items without slowing down your site. You can show Product Ratings, Sale price and Hide Out-of-Stock items from showing up in the Related Products slider for all products.

6. Can I keep a log of all my AI generated prompts?

Yes, the Related Products Pro for WooCommerce keeps a log of all AI-generated item suggestions, including details like date, time, and token usage, so you can monitor and adjust AI product items whenever needed.
